outcome: Clinical characteristics of COVID-19 in pregnancy
Presence of SARS-CoV-2 in amniotic fluid
Presence of SARS-CoV-2 in cord blood
Presence of SARS-CoV-2 in neonatal throat swab samples
Presence of SARS-CoV-2 in breastmilk samples
cohort: Nine pregnant women with laboratory-confirmed COVID-19 pneumonia admitted to Zhongnan Hospital of Wuhan University, Wuhan, China, from Jan 20 to Jan 31, 2020.
finding: The clinical characteristics of COVID-19 pneumonia in pregnant women were similar to those reported for non-pregnant adults, and there was no evidence of intrauterine vertical transmission of COVID-19 from mothers to their babies.
